sources.summary: Since 2026-04-28, uploads require Xcode 26 or later and iOS/iPadOS 26 SDK or later. Updated age-rating questionnaire was due 2026-01-31. Required Reason API declarations are required for covered APIs used by app and third-party code.

sources.summary: Review needs complete functional binaries, live backend access and working credentials; replacing a legally unavailable demo account with demo mode requires prior Apple approval. Screenshots must show the app in use; featured extra purchases need disclosure. Digital unlocks normally use IAP, and restorable purchases need restoration. Account creation requires in-app deletion. Kids Category gates purchases and external links, restricts third-party data/analytics, and differs from merely having Child Mode. Child-primary marketing is reserved for Kids Category. Apps need utility beyond a repackaged website.
Kids Category uses age bands 5 and under, 6-8, and 9-11. Parental gates precede purchases and external destinations; a gate is not a substitute for legal consent to process child data.

Localized app name is 2-30 characters; subtitle at most 30. Privacy policy URL is required for iOS. Age rating applies across platforms. Made for Kids cannot be changed after approval. Primary language supplies metadata fallback. Content rights are territory-specific; China book content may require NPPA permission.

Answer controls, capabilities and content-frequency questions accurately. Calculated 4+ or 9+ apps may request Made for Kids. That choice cannot change after approval. A higher EULA age requires a corresponding age-rating override.

For EU distribution Apple verifies/displays trader address, phone and email. Individuals may use an address or P.O. Box; organizations use their D-U-N-S address. Account Holder/Admin completes factual status and contact verification. Paid activity informs, but does not mechanically settle, trader self-assessment.

sources.summary: Any encryption use, including OS-provided crypto, requires an export-compliance determination. Distribution territories and actual encryption inventory matter; absence of document upload does not mean absence of assessment.

Apple's table says OS-only encryption needs no App Store Connect documentation; external industry-standard encryption requires a French declaration when distributing in France; proprietary encryption requires CCATS and, for France, the French declaration. This is not an app-specific legal classification.

Answer the App Store Connect encryption questionnaire. Required documents must be completed before App Review or TestFlight App Review; description and territory availability support Apple's assessment.

sources.summary: English (U.S.) and Russian are supported metadata localizations. Storefront, device language, available languages and primary language influence what a customer sees; app locale and store locale must be validated separately.

Metadata and binary localization are separate. New locale screenshots/properties initially copy the primary language except description/keywords. Add and validate explicit Russian/English assets; absence of a matching locale triggers fallback.

sources.summary: Intl.DisplayNames accepts BCP 47 locale identifiers and region/language display types. Default missing-name fallback returns the code; fallback none returns undefined. Application logic must supply a reviewed fallback to avoid raw identifiers on critical UI.
The current BCP 47 index comprises RFC 4647 for language matching and RFC 5646 for language-tag structure. Use valid language tags and a deterministic locale negotiation policy.

decisions.decision: Enforce Xcode >=26 with iOS/iPadOS SDK >=26. Candidate installed toolchain may be Xcode 26.6/SDK26.5; record exact host output at build stage. Do not use stale upload compatibility table to relax the gate.
Preserve paid upfront with optional restorable non-consumable Apple IAP. Do not enable alternative EU payments from a documentation refresh; recheck terms before 2026-10-01.
String Catalog translated-state and agent-generated translations are workflow states, not editorial evidence. Critical units still need approved source hashes and bilingual review.
Decide Kids Category from final audience/content and owner declaration. Child Mode alone is not that category; reserve child-primary metadata until category determination.
Default to locally generated dry-run payloads. App Store Connect metadata updates are real mutations even while version is a draft. No submit/release/deploy/merge performed.
